pathBase: workspace root; all paths are relative to /storage/Users/currentUser/dev/redalert-godot-csharp

scope.rawSources: Retained SHP/VXL/HVA/PAL files plus SHP-format Visual/Scenery .tem files; duplicate content at different paths is retained.

sprites.name: Existing conversion folder stem; not unique across allied/soviet interface roots.
sprites.manifest: Workspace-relative original conversion manifest or custom cursor catalog.
sprites.sourceSha256: Lowercase SHA256 of original source bytes.
sprites.paletteSha256: Lowercase SHA256 of original 768-byte PAL bytes; not PNG colors.
sprites.sourceFile: Original source filename as stated in conversion metadata.
sprites.shadowLayout: Verbatim standard SHP field; null means field absent in custom cursor catalog.
sprites.manifestFormat: shp-ts-ra2 for normal conversion metadata; cursor-catalog uses a different structure.
sprites.sourcePaths: Retained originals with matching source hash.
sprites.palettePaths: Retained palettes with matching palette hash.

voxels.manifest: westwood-voxel-atlas/v1 metadata; paths in part artifact fields and composite resolve relative to this manifest.

parts.name: Exact semantic role, e.g. body/turret/barrel.
parts.source: Exact original VXL part filename from the vehicle manifest.
parts.hvaSha256: SHA256 of original HVA bytes; compare this in addition to VXL hash.

rawSources.name: Original filename from provenance where available; otherwise retained basename.
rawSources.sha256: Computed from file bytes during inventory.

existingCameos.name: Original icon basename without .png; lowercase lookup keys are provided.
existingCameos.pngSha256: SHA256 of retained PNG bytes; distinct from original SHP sourceSha256.
existingCameos.sourceSha256: Present for SHP-derived cameos: SHA256 of original SHP bytes. Absent for third-party PNG copies without retained SHP provenance.
existingCameos.paletteSha256: Present for SHP-derived cameos: SHA256 of original PAL bytes.

indexSchemas.spritesBySourceAndPalette: Key = sourceSha256 + colon + paletteSha256; value = list of zero-based positions in sprites. Multiple conversions may match; inspect shadowLayout/layout/manifestFormat.
indexSchemas.voxelsBySourceSha256: Key = original VXL source SHA256; value = list of {voxel,part} zero-based positions into voxels and its parts. This is candidate matching, not proof of interchangeable rendered atlases.
indexSchemas.rawSourcesBySha256: Original source SHA256 -> zero-based positions in rawSources.
indexSchemas.rawSourcesByOriginalName: Lowercase original filename including extension -> zero-based positions in rawSources; may be ambiguous.
indexSchemas.cameosByOriginalIconName: Lowercase original icon basename without .png -> zero-based positions in existingCameos.
indexSchemas.cameosByFilename: Lowercase original PNG basename including .png -> zero-based positions in existingCameos.

vehicleManifestSemantics.directionDegrees: direction * 11.25; direction 0 projects +X right; positive counterclockwise in world XY
vehicleManifestSemantics.anchor: Shared atlas anchor for every part and facing of one assembled model; retain original model anchor and cell dimensions.

projection.handedness: VXL X preserved, Y reflected, Z up
projection.angle: positive counterclockwise in world XY; direction 0 projects +X right
projection.origin: VXL/HVA model origin; shared across parts and facings; no per-part recentering
projection.modelTransform: world = footerScale * reflectY(HVA.linear * (boundsMin + grid * (boundsMax-boundsMin)/size) + HVA.translation * footerScale * (boundsMax-boundsMin)/size)

teamColor.pngEncoding: RGB ramp 1..255; alpha 255 only on team pixels; source ramp order retained

vehicleManifestSemantics.raw: Full atlas, row-major, one byte per pixel, no header; indices/normals require alpha.bin coverage (0 transparent, 255 covered).
vehicleManifestSemantics.lighting: Exposed voxel face normals from neighbor occupancy; source VXL normal indices are retained but not used for lighting.

reuseCaveats: Match original source bytes by SHA256; original filenames alone can be ambiguous and names are case-insensitive on this filesystem.

For SHP reuse compare palette hash, shadowLayout, manifestFormat and layout; retain frame role/pairedFrame/imageRect/sourceRect/centerOffset and image-set metadata. Battlefield standard SHP manifests use second-half shadows.
The cursor catalog has a custom schema with full-native-canvas frames and no declared shadowLayout. Its entry is indexed for completeness but cannot be consumed as a standard shp-ts-ra2 manifest.
Scenery .tem sources in this inventory are SHP-format sprite payloads; their reference provenance may label them TEM. Terrain tile conversions are excluded.
For vehicle reuse compare every required part role/source SHA, HVA SHA/identityPose, animationFrame, palette and projection. VXL SHA alone establishes only a candidate.
Rendered vehicle part frames share complete-model cell bounds and origin anchors. A different part assembly can require new rasterization even if an individual source VXL is identical.
Grand Cannon has turret and barrel only; the building body is the separate gggcan SHP sprite. Chrono Miner has a body part only.

unittem.pal has the same original hash across SHP and voxel outputs, but SHP expansion is channel << 2 (0..252) and vehicle metadata stores its own expandedRgb; preserve renderer-specific color encoding.
Original-name cameo PNGs include both local SHP conversions and retained third-party PNG copies. Icon name and dimensions do not prove a new SHP/palette conversion would produce identical pixels.
This is a snapshot of pre-existing reusable assets. ClassicExpansion outputs owned by the extraction agent are deliberately excluded.
